worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.summary: A charming cry fills the whole space around the singer, so foes inside it cannot escape and it never misses; it rattles their timing, and the soothing form also takes the edge off their attacks.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.descrip: Each caught target takes %1$s damage across a %2$s block sound field.
Caught foes lose %1$s stage of Speed; the wave expands at %2$s blocks per tick.
The soothing form also drops Attack by %1$s stage, and the charm lasts %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
At level %1$s: the sound field widens to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.0: A sound field centred on the singer
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.1: Rattle a whole ring of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.use.2: Sooth a ring of foes to take their edge off
worldcombat.skill.disarmingvoice.prefere: On: caught targets also lose Attack and carry the charm identity, but power is x0.85 with 3 ticks more windup and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a full-power plain cry that only staggers, and it is faster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of singing. Larger values let it open from further.
On: singing jumps in priority when another foe stands near the target, so one cry catches a ring. Off: order it like a plain attack.
On: the user may leave its post to catch more foes; off: it only sings from where it stands.
